subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow diagnostic details should OpenClaw show in user-visible channel replies across Discord, webchat, CLI, and auto-reply fallbacks?
rationale: The code already has many requested facts, but exposing session/channel labels, raw identifiers, model names, and token counts is a product and privacy policy choice that automation should not settle.

options.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
options.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token-budget facts through a shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.

options.title: Keep details in logs/status only
options.body: Preserve generic channel replies and rely on debug logs, status, or diagnostics for operator-level context details.

options.title: Fold into broader context visibility
options.body: Track this under a larger compaction visibility design covering warnings, notifications, and recovery UX instead of a narrow message-only change.

recommendation.title: Approve redaction-aware diagnostics
recommendation.body: Show safe display labels plus model and token-budget facts through a shared formatter, with raw identifiers redacted or omitted by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history across the affected runner, auto-reply, and formatter surfaces and already provided prior review context on this issue.
